question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4**
solution:
The correct answer is "**unbelievable**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **unhealthy: **harmful to health.
 
• **unbelievable: **not able to be believed; unlikely to be true.
 
• **unlimited: **not limited or restricted in terms of number, quantity, or extent.
 
• **unlucky: **having, bringing, or resulting from bad luck.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, **"unbelievable**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The speaker could not believe that they could have so much fun without TV.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

**The complete passage is: **I decided to stay away from television* **(1) for*** a whole year. After a week, I started feeling ***(2) depressed*__.** But, my friend Bess cheered me up. She*** (3) encouraged* **me every day and would take me places. It was *(4) unbelievable *how much fun we had without TV. My life had become more ***(5) exciting*** without the good old idiot box.
